voltage_levels.voltage_note: New transmission substation in Östra Hälsingland; voltage classes not separately enumerated in the procurement Gantt. Likely 220/400 kV given its role replacing the decommissioned 220 kV stations Ljusdal/Dönje/Söderala.

scope_description: New transmission substation as part of the Östra Hälsingland reorganization (decommissioning of 220 kV at Ljusdal, Dönje, Söderala in favor of a new transmission node at Njutånger).

timeline.timeline_note: Commission marker visible on the Gantt around 2027. Listed as 'separate' package — flagged as 'Behöver inte vara med' (does not need to be included in this Q1-2026 procurement round).

contract.contract_note: Listed as separate package. Source flag 'Behöver inte vara med' indicates not part of this procurement round.

narrative_note: Njutånger is the new transmission substation that replaces the decommissioned 220 kV nodes at Ljusdal, Dönje, and Söderala under the Östra Hälsingland reorganization (slide 7).
